caption: The drawing consists of multiple outlined pattern pieces and components arranged over a faded beige or off-white paper background. The lines and texts are rendered in black or dark gray pencil or ink. Across the page, there are various elongated and irregularly shaped pieces labeled with alphanumeric codes such as A-3, A-1, B-5-1, etc. Each pattern piece is depicted with dashed lines indicating fold lines, edges, or stitching allowances, and they are oriented differently within a rectangular border. Toward the center right is a vertical strip labeled "CENTER BACK," and above it are two long, thin rectangular strips, labeled B-6 (2) and B-5 (2). At the bottom left, there is a circular rosette shape labeled B-8 and a bow shape labeled A-5 (5) B-7. Several pattern pieces are labelled as “bodice” or “sleeve,” and the center of the page is occupied by three adjoining shapes labeled as “B-1,” “B-2,” “B-3” and “CENTER FRONT.” Surrounding the pattern pieces, there is a detailed, handwritten text in black, describing the purpose and placement of each piece, as well as sewing instructions and assembly guides. Some of the pattern pieces are also subdivided with internally numbered parts or notches. The page is bordered with a thin, straight line forming a wide rectangular area for the diagram, and there are faint traces of aging, such as spots, slight discoloration, and a transparent tape mark on the upper right corner. A fine measurement scale is included in the bottom right corner.
title: Dress Pattern
